# Globs excluded from the coverage gate (tool/check_coverage.dart --exclude).
# Single source of truth: ci.yml reads this file, and README.md and
# CONTRIBUTING.md run the same command from it. One glob per line; blank lines
# and lines starting with # are ignored. Add a rationale for every entry, and
# prefer a test over a new exclusion.

# gen_l10n output, regenerated from lib/l10n/*.arb; nothing hand-written.
lib/l10n/app_localizations*.dart

# Constants only (colors, radii); no branches or logic to execute.
lib/core/theme/app_theme_tokens.dart

# Route path string constants only.
lib/app/navigation/app_routes.dart

# Pure widget wiring of the platform-adaptive navigation shell; covered by the
# on-device integration tests (integration_test/), not by unit tests.
lib/app/widgets/app_bottom_nav.dart

# Thin wrappers around platform plugins (location, share, url_launcher,
# app_links, ...). They only forward to the plugin, which cannot run in unit
# tests; the logic that uses them is tested through their abstract interfaces.
lib/core/services/platform/*.dart

# The health package boundary (HealthKit / Health Connect); needs a real
# platform. The mapping logic around it lives in separately tested files.
lib/features/health/services/health_package_platform_adapter.dart

# The universal_ble boundary; needs real Bluetooth hardware. Decoding and
# profile logic live in separately tested files.
lib/features/sensors/services/universal_ble_sensor_connection_adapter.dart

# Diagnostics source and event name constants only; no logic to execute.
lib/core/diagnostics/diagnostics_events.dart
